title: Cleaning correlation matrices with external information: the Maximum Variance estimat
abstract: arXiv:2611.30843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rotationally invariant estimators clean the eigenvalues of an empirical correlation matrix but keep its noisy eigenvectors. We study an estimator that corrects the eigenvectors by using external information, namely a partition of the assets into groups such as asset classes or regions. The Maximum Variance (MaxVar) estimator restricts the leading eigenvectors to linear combinations of the maximum-variance portfolios of the groups and replaces the rest of the spectrum by a single eigenvalue. It is a factor model with about n parameters instead of n2/2, and it is positive de nite even when the number of observations is smaller than the number of assets n. We apply it to the correlation matrix of 47 futures on stock indices, bonds and currencies, with the three asset classes as groups. translated_title: 利用外部信息清洗相关矩阵：最大方差估计量
translated_abstract: 旋转不变估计量能够清洗经验相关矩阵的特征值，但会保留其含噪声的特征向量。我们研究了一种利用外部信息来修正特征向量的估计量，即利用外部信息将资产划分为不同的组别，例如资产类别或地区。最大方差估计量将主特征向量限制为各组最大方差投资组合的线性组合，并用单一特征值替换频谱的其余部分。它是一个大约包含 n 个参数（而非 n²/2 个参数）的因子模型，并且即使在观测次数少于资产数量 n 的情况下也能保持正定。我们将其应用于包含股票指数、债券和货币三类共 47 种期货的相关矩阵，以这三个资产类别作为分组。在一个说明性的蒙特卡洛测试中——其中参考矩阵具有该估计量所假设的结构——与参考矩阵的距离被显著降低了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用外部资产分组信息修正相关矩阵特征向量的最大方差估计量，它将因子模型参数从 n²/2 降至约 n 个，即使在观测数少于资产数时仍保持正定，并能显著减小与参考矩阵的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the MaxVar estimator, which uses external asset grouping information to correct noisy eigenvectors of correlation matrices, reducing factor model parameters from n²/2 to about n while remaining positive definite even with fewer observations than assets, and significantly shrinking the distance to the reference matrix.
